claim: The Gadaladeniya rock inscription dates the Buddhist shrine's foundation to 1344, under Bhuvanaikabahu IV, and names the sthavira Dharmakirtti; the record also documents endowed lands and a South Indian-associated architect, Ganesvaracari.
bounded_by: This anchors Gadaladeniya specifically. It does not by itself prove a uniform Gampola-wide revival or all details of GF-SAS-14 concerning Niyamgampaya and Lankatilaka.
notes: Promotes the epigraphically secured portion of GF-SAS-14.
